posts.name: Maggie
posts.cooked:
Hi everyone!

I just posted this all over social media, surprise, but I wanted to ensure anyone not following us had a chance to submit questions.

This month's Sentinels of the Multiverse: OblivAeon update is coming to you in the form of a live Q&A through Kickstarter! Tomorrow we will be testing the live stream at 11 AM and there will be a brief update! Please stop by to help us out if you can. If not remember you can send questions to maggie@greaterthangames.com until Feb. 13!
